looks.name: goldenhour
looks.composition: layered depth: one sharp foreground detail on the right, the working scene unfolding in soft focus behind it
looks.tone: late-afternoon golden light raking low through a doorway or window, long warm shadows, darker overall
looks.treatment: 35mm lens at f/2.8, warm natural colour, gentle film texture, cinematic editorial photography

looks.name: flatlay
looks.composition: overhead view looking straight down onto a work surface where the story is laid out: six to nine related objects arranged with intent
looks.tone: even soft daylight from a nearby window, mid-tone, true colours
looks.treatment: crisp editorial still-life photography, soft natural shadows, tactile materials

looks.name: macro
looks.composition: a close detail filling the right half of the frame, with the wider room still readable in the soft background
looks.treatment: 100mm macro lens at f/4, fine texture detail — wood grain, brass, linen, paper fibre

looks.name: blueprint
looks.composition: an illustrated scene with real depth and many small details, like a commissioned magazine cover illustration
looks.tone: muted harmonious palette of four or five colours, soft flat light
looks.treatment: gouache and ink illustration with visible brush texture — clearly an illustration, not a photograph

looks.name: daylight
looks.composition: wide establishing view of the property in its setting, the landscape giving a strong sense of place
looks.tone: bright, sunlit, airy, saturated but natural sky
looks.treatment: 24mm lens, crisp midday light and strong shadow shapes, travel-editorial photography

looks.name: nightfall
looks.composition: exterior or terrace at dusk, lit windows and lanterns, the building framed against the sky
looks.tone: deep blue hour, cool sky against warm practical light, quiet
looks.treatment: 35mm lens, long-exposure feel, glowing interiors, calm cinematic mood

looks.name: interior
looks.composition: a lived-in interior at working pace — lobby, back office, housekeeping store or kitchen pass — people only as soft-focus figures
looks.tone: warm practical lamps mixed with window daylight
looks.treatment: documentary editorial photography, 28mm lens, natural imperfections, honest textures

looks.name: aerial
looks.composition: high aerial drone view looking down at an angle onto the property and its surroundings, the building small in a big place
looks.tone: clear late-morning light, rich landscape colour
looks.treatment: drone photography, sharp landscape detail, strong sense of geography

cities.name: Dar es Salaam
cities.note: business travel, high turnover, corporate accounts
cities.visual: glass business towers along the Kivukoni waterfront, harbour cranes and dhows offshore, corporate hotel lobbies, humid Indian Ocean light

cities.name: Arusha
cities.note: safari season peaks, group bookings, tour operator invoicing
cities.visual: jacaranda-lined avenues, Mount Meru on the horizon, safari Land Cruisers with pop-up roofs, coffee estates, timber lodge verandas

cities.name: Zanzibar
cities.note: resorts, long stays, foreign currency and OTA commissions
cities.visual: Stone Town coral-stone walls and carved brass-studded doors, makuti-thatched beach resorts, turquoise shallows, dhows with lateen sails

cities.name: Mwanza
cities.note: lake tourism and regional conferences, smaller teams
cities.visual: granite boulders rising out of Lake Victoria, Bismarck Rock, lakeside conference hotels, fishing boats pulled up at dawn

cities.name: Moshi
cities.note: Kilimanjaro trekking groups, seasonal spikes, porters and guides
cities.visual: Kilimanjaro's snow cap above banana and coffee farms, trekking duffels and boots, porters' kit, highland lodges with stone fireplaces
